module: Manages the user's anonymous ID used by telemetry. A random "salt" is created once and stored in `/telemetry/salt.txt`; the ID is the SHA-256 hash of that file. An old `/gameTelemetries/.salt` file is migrated automatically to keep the same ID.
notes: The salt file contains an explanatory banner (link to the privacy policy) followed by 6 lines of 80 random hexadecimal characters (`SecureComm.getRandomBytesHexSlow(40)`).
The hash covers the whole content of the file read, banner included; during a migration, the old content is copied as is, without a banner, so as not to change the ID.
Each call of getAnonymousUserID rereads the file and recomputes the hash (no cache).
The extension sets itself to manual unload on load.

getAnonymousUserID.desc: Returns the anonymous ID: the SHA-256 hash (`hashStringSHA256`) of the salt. Creates or migrates the salt file if needed (`telemetry` folder created as needed).

returns.desc: SHA-256 hash of the salt file's contents.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads. Sets the extension to manual unload to avoid its automatic unload.
